Name: Playable Submas
Author: kcbsnxbd
Description:
[size=4][b]Features[/b][/size]

[url=https://youtu.be/vGedaLjl2Y0]Mod gameplay demo link[/url]

[color=#D4D4D8]This is a mod that lets you play as Ingo, and gives you Emmet as a companion that follows you everywhere (he’s considered a trinket in the game’s code, though you don’t need combat mastery and he doesn’t take up the trinket slot). This is not an npc mod— there are no friendship values and no heart events, and the mod adds no story elements.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
You can talk to Emmet (and Ingo can talk to him). Emmet will automatically forage, dig artifact spots, pet animals, and fight enemies. All items go into your inventory, and you get full experience from his actions.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
If you talk to Emmet while holding one of four items: ice cream, coffee, pizza, and beer, you can ‘feed’ it to him. This will do nothing except consume the item and give you the corresponding textbox. The ‘gift’ sound effect is just for immersion, and it does not affect Emmet’s friendship (he has no friendship value; he always loves Ingo). This functionality exists purely because I wanted to give him treats.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]The mod also reskins the ginger cat to be a Joltik – a purely cosmetic change, doesn’t affect the pet’s behaviour or gifts (or voice; the Joltik go meow, which I think is kind of cute).[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
The mod also edits the player’s expressions so that Ingo won’t smile with his mouth. This takes effect regardless of whether you are dressed as Ingo or not, and the only way to disable it is to get rid of the mod.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
The coffee maker gives you two cups of coffee per day. This is also regardless of whether you are dressed as Ingo.

You can talk to Emmet by overlapping your sprite with Emmet’s and pressing the ‘interact’ key. The default is ‘LeftAlt+MouseRight’, can be changed in the Trinket Tinker config (NOT Playable Submas’s config!! Playabe Submas doesn’t have a config file). (If you use the default settings, or otherwise bind it to a click, you don’t have to click ON Emmet – the relevant condition is the sprites overlapping.)

This is not a very polished mod. I made it for my own use, optimised for my own playthrough, and it shows.

I personally interpret the twins’ relationship as a very close, intimate, platonic life partnership, and the dialogue between the twins reflects that.[/color]

[size=4][b]Setup[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]Start a new game, and set up your farmer as in the screenshot below. You need to set up the farmer’s appearance exactly as shown here if you want Ingo to look identical to Emmet. (The hair and shirt doesn’t matter, it will be overwritten later)[/color]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52355/52355-1791323397-421845222.png[/img]
[color=#D4D4D8]
The name you put in as your farmer name does not affect Ingo and Emmet’s dialogue or the display names; they will always use their respective names. I would recommend you call yourself something like ‘Ingo & Emmet’, so that it feels like the npcs are talking to both of you.
(‘Ingo and Emmet’ or ‘Subway Bosses’ don’t fit in the name box. You can bypass this limit by editing your save file directly. It’s fairly easy (the Stardew Wiki says you need specific software, but for just the name change you can use any text editor) and I haven’t noticed any side effects during my playthrough, but still use with discretion.)[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
Once the game actually starts, go outside and check your mailbox. You will have a letter containing the Hand Mirror. Hold the Mirror in your hands and left click like using a tool. Press the dresser icon on the right panel, then the ‘Presets’ button, and then select the ‘Subway Boss (Black)’ option (the text for this is formatted weirdly (for my setup at least), but it should still be readable). Exit the menu.[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]You should now be dressed as Ingo! Change loading zones twice (fastest way is to go back into the farmhouse, then straight back out) and Emmet should appear. Put the mirror in a chest somewhere – you don’t need it anymore, but the game doesn’t let you throw it away.[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/52355/52355-1791401599-514559665.png[/img][/color]



And you’re done! Enjoy the game!

[size=4][b]Recommended mods to use with this mod[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8][u]Mods I consider basically essential for immersion[/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/722]Gender Neutrality Mod[/url]: So that people will use they/them for the twins. Also lets you set some other terms plural (boys, lads, guys…) but this results in weird grammar in places.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29637]Grandpa’s stardrop[/url]: Gives you the spouse stardrop when you achieve 4 candles on grandpa’s evaluation. Lets you get perfection without having to marry/roommate anyone

[u]Other recommended mods[/u]
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43156]Model Trains and Locomotives[/url]: The boys need their trains! If you have both Model Trains and Playable Submas installed, the price for Train Catalogue sold by Robin goes down from 100,000g to 100g, so that you can have it at the start of the game.
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2529]Pokefy[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50344]Pelipper Town[/url] / [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49098]Pokémon Eggventure[/url] (maybe not all three at once!): Fill the valley with Pokémon! Any other Pokémon mod works as well.
If you use Pokefy with this mod, you should set the cat to ‘None’ in the Pokefy config, so that it doesn’t overwrite the Joltik. Also, note that my pet Joltik sprite is identical to the wild Joltik added by Pelipper Town. This is because both my mod and the Pelliper Town mod use the PMD spritebase as the sprite source.[/color]



[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[color=#D4D4D8]The mod should be compatible with most other mods, with the exceptions being those that change the farmer’s base body frame, and those that reskin the ginger cat.[/color]


[b][size=4]Known quirks[/size][/b]
 
[list]
[*][size=2]Pathing is weird. Emmet will go through walls and walk on water at some points, especially on narrow roads/bridges.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Sometimes Emmet will go stand by forage/a digspot/an animal without actually doing anything. Move away a little and then come back, or wait a moment for him to do the thing (or do it yourself of course).[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]In cutscenes: Emmet will stand on top of npcs in some cases. In cases where the player location changes quickly, it might take him a few seconds to walk back to Ingo’s side from where he used to be.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Emmet won’t appear in the movie-watching cutscenes in the movie theatre. Ingo’s arms are sometimes misaligned with his body in the movie cutscenes as well.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Emmet won’t try to pet the farm animals when they’re sleeping, but will still go stand beside them if they haven’t been pet that day.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]Emmet will walk on water when Ingo is swimming. He will not change into swim clothes.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]You can technically put hats on the Joltik, but they’d be in the wrong places.[/size][/*]
[*][size=2]You may see parts of Ingo’s normal sprite behind the ‘hug’ animation depending on how he and Emmet are positioned, especially if he’s on a horse, or if you clear the dialogue box quickly and then immediately move. I couldn’t find a way to make the normal sprite invisible during it, which is why the big heart was necessary in the first place.[/size][/*]
[/list]
